[#october.month,leaf=18]
== [.mon]#VIII Mon.# October hath xxxi days.

image::blank.svg[role=spacer,pdfwidth=1pt,pdfheight=8.93pt]

[.verse-line]
[.i256]##{nbsp}##Time was my spouse and I could not agree,
[.i148]##{nbsp}##Striving about superiority:
[.i130]##{nbsp}##The text which saith that man and wife are one,
[.i155]##{nbsp}##Was the chief argument we stood upon:
[.i148]##{nbsp}##She held, they both one woman should become;
[.i142]##{nbsp}##I held they should be man, and both but one.
[.i130]##{nbsp}##Thus we contended daily, but the strife
[.i148]##{nbsp}##Could not be ended, till both were one Wife.
